caseNarrative:
XX/XX/year> : Attempted to deposit 2 checks into a Capitol One approved atm located at XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, IL XXXX. 
I deposited 2 checks 1 for {$130.00} and 1 for {$750.00}. I inserted my debit card, entered my pin, followed the instructions on the screen, I stacked the checks as directed and inserted them into the machine. The machine then displayed a photo of the checks and instructed me to verify the amount of the 2 checks. 
The machine then displayed a message saying the transaction could not be processed and it appeared to attempt to return the checks to me. The door of the slot to insert checks opened but the checks did not eject. The machine then produced 2 receipts, 1 stating " Transaction Not Allowed '', 1 other receipt stating, " One or more deposit items were unable to be returned due to a technical problem ''. The screen displayed a message instructing me to take the receipt to the teller to correct the issue. This was a Sunday. I went to the bank the next morning and was instructed by the employees to take the matter up with Capital One as they were unable to help. 

XX/XX/year> : I filed a claim concerning the matter with Capital One. They deposited a temporary credit into my account for the amount of the 2 checks. 

XX/XX/year> : I sent Capital One images of the 2 receipts produced by the atm and information about the bank & atm location. 

XX/XX/year> : Capital One informed me that my claim had been denied. I contacted Capital One and was told the denial was due to " An inability to reach the merchant ''. I asked that the case be reopened as that reason did not make sense since I was able to call the bank, they should be able as well. I was told by the customer service rep that the case would be reopened. 
I sent Capital One a screenshot of their website listing the location of the atm I used, a photo of the atm along with the previously sent images of the atm receipts. 

XX/XX/year> : I sent Capitol One the telephone number of the bank 's branch manager to resolve their inability to reach the merchant. 

XX/XX/year> : Capital One emailed me to inform me that the denial will stand. I called to find out the reason and was told that this time it was due to my using the wrong atm. I informed the rep that I used an atm listed on their website as a Capital One approved atm. I asked that they check their site so they would see the only reason I tried to use that atm is because their site listed the atm. 

XX/XX/year> : Captial One emailed me that their denial still stands. 

XX/XX/year> : I received the documentation from Capital One. The documents are just copies of my account statement for the date of the credits they gave me for the checks. There is no information on how they came to the decision to deny my claim.
